method: Independent source-only review of the acceptance runner, its sanitized report, inventory acceptance, and reset implementation. No test, browser, build, install, or process was run.

verdict_a_acceptance_and_runtime.runtime_status: UNVERIFIED; this lane did not execute the runner
acceptance_evidence: Runner performs real web login, extension Settings sign-in, Cancel, Confirm, then native panel reload in harness-owned profile.
Cancel checks signed-in admin UI, auth presence, Dark preference, exact disposable local/session fixture values, and no loss of prior keys.
Confirm checks both fixtures and every preexisting local/session key absent immediately; reload then checks guest/System state and no prior non-regenerated key names.
This matches T51's cancel-preserves / confirm-clears-and-signs-out expectation across warm and reload dimensions.
verdict_a_acceptance_and_runtime.corrected_reload_proof: Confirmed prior gap is repaired: snapshots remain in process memory; the post-reload intersection is asserted across all prior local/session key names except narrowly listed regenerated-key sets. Immediate post-confirm intersection has no exceptions. No storage values are serialized.
verdict_a_acceptance_and_runtime.remaining_limit: The reload name comparison is only an oracle for keys present before reset. Listed regenerated names can reappear after clearing by fresh boot; the immediate post-confirm assertion proves those same prior keys were absent before reload. No runtime evidence is claimed.

evidence: The runner drives Settings UI instead of invoking reset implementation directly; reset implementation clears extension local/session storage before signOut (SettingsView.tsx:147-149).
Credential values stay at the real web form; storage inspection returns auth-key booleans, names, theme and fixture equality only. Output is an allowlisted object with restrictive mode.

The harness uses its owned disposable Chrome profile and no application-data mutation route is present in runner source. Real sign-in and sign-out can create/revoke disposable authentication sessions; this is correctly disclosed in the runner report.
verdict_b_correctness_and_safety.confirmed_prior_finding: admin-reset-source-peer's missing post-reload all-key comparison was valid for ff6b609 and is repaired by 0322640.
verdict_b_correctness_and_safety.runtime_safety_boundary: Source supports isolation and credential handling; only the root-admitted guarded native run can establish actual browser/profile behavior.
